column2: “employer”  means  any  person  who  on  his  own  behalf
employs,  or  on  whose  behalf  any  other  person
employs, any worker in any trade and includes any
person who on behalf of any other person employs
occupation,  profession  or  calling,  carried  on,
performed or exercised by an employer or worker,
and any branch of, or any function or process in any
trade, but does not include any industry, business or
undertaking which is carried on by any corporation,
board or other body which was or is established by
or under any written law where the Government holds
a majority of the share capital with funds or capital
wholly  or  partly  provided  by  the  Government  by
way of grant, loan or otherwise ;
